title: NGS Library Cleanup with Ampure XP Beads
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters, setting “park tips” to yes (recommended) to conserve tips and “track tips across protocol runs” to yes (or no) as desired.

steps.title: Download generated protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file after the parameters have been entered.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place a NEST 96‑deepwell plate (2 mL) in slot 7. Load Ampure XP beads in column 1, 80 % ethanol in column 2, EB buffer in column 3, and empty liquid‑waste reservoirs in columns 10‑12 (loaded empty at start).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the deck, tip racks, and the P300 multi‑channel electronic pipette (GEN2); use calibration tips as described.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the protocol.
